html:
SMTO-SCH-0032 — Too many attachments for a scheduled task

GUID: e682bb39-32dd-4e1e-ae51-348cf848cb6a
Slug: schedule-context-limit
Domain: SCH · Subsystem: sch

What happened

  • A scheduled task can bring along at most 16 attached files or items. This one had more, so the schedule was not created.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. In the message box, remove attachments you don't need by selecting the × next to each one. Each attached file or item counts toward the limit of 16.
  2. If the task truly needs more than 16 items, split it into separate requests, each with its own schedule and its own attachments. Each schedule has its own limit of 16, so smaller tasks fit.
  3. Before scheduling again, open Schedules and check that this task wasn't already scheduled. This avoids ending up with two copies of the same schedule.

What success looks like

  • The schedule is created and appears on the Schedules page with the right Next run time.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO, along with how many items you attached. Don't remove items the task really needs just to get under the limit; split the task instead.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Scheduled work can capture at most 16 context sources.

What this means

  • Captured schedule context_refs contains more than 16 normalized supported source IDs. Schedule configuration and temporal checks do not themselves launch deferred work. Existing event/request identities, captured authority and original execution receipts remain authoritative; diagnostic rendering does not poll time or mutate scheduling state.

Why this can happen

  • Captured schedule context_refs contains more than 16 normalized supported source IDs.

How to diagnose it

  • Count selected references and preserve required evidence when splitting independent scheduled work.

How to fix it

  • scheduled_agent_scope rejects context_refs with more than 16 distinct ctx_ IDs (events/scope.py). Reduce the attached context sources to 16 or fewer, keeping the ones the task needs, or split independent work into separate schedules.
  • Reduce the selected sources to 16 or fewer while keeping the required task evidence. Split independent work into separate schedules when appropriate.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The intended schedule captures at most 16 supported necessary sources.

What not to do

  • Do not bypass scope or ownership checks to force a larger operation through.

Technical notes

  • Schedule configuration and temporal checks do not themselves launch deferred work. Existing event/request identities, captured authority and original execution receipts remain authoritative; diagnostic rendering does not poll time or mutate scheduling state.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
